description: MainActivity.java defines the main activity for an Android application, extending SampleActivityBase. It manages fragment transactions to load SwipeRefreshListFragmentFragment, handles menu options to toggle a log view, and sets up logging facilities for the app.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The main activity that sets up UI components, manages fragment transactions, menu handling, and logging setup for the Android application.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the fragment if this is the first creation.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from XML resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu by setting the visibility and title of the log toggle option.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically toggling the log view display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain, wrapping Android logs, filtering messages, and attaching a log fragment view.
